title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant Oldfield Accountancy & Advisory is looking for a highly organised, proactive Executive Assistant to support its Leadership Team on a full-time, permanent basis, based in Coventry, West Midlands.

Fantastic company benefits include:
- Competitive Salary:£35,000 - £45,000 per annum, depending on experience
- Holiday: 30 days annual leave, including bank holidays
- Hybrid and flexible working
- Additional Benefits: Company car or car allowance, profit share scheme and private healthcare after a qualifying period, plus free quality lunch four days a week, reward lunches, team building days, professional development opportunities, and a supportive and collaborative working environment.

About the role:

As an Executive Assistant, you will provide high-level support to the Leadership Team, managing diaries, meetings, events, reports, projects and key deadlines while acting as a trusted link with the wider business. You will be proactive, commercially aware and highly organised, with the discretion to handle confidential information and the confidence to anticipate priorities, work independently and ensure tasks are followed through.

Duties and Responsibilities include:
- Manage Leadership Team calendars, meetings, appointments and priorities, ensuring schedules run smoothly
- Prepare agendas, meeting papers, presentations and regular reports, ensuring accurate and timely information
- Coordinate meetings, offsites, strategy days and client events, including venues, catering and technology
- Take minutes, track actions and deadlines, and proactively follow up to ensure tasks are completed
- Manage Leadership Team inboxes and act as a key communication link with the wider business
- Support projects and ad hoc business requirements while handling sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion

About you:

To be a successful Executive Assistant, you will have proven experience providing executive or senior-level administrative support, ideally within a professional services or accountancy environment. You will be highly organised, proactive and confident managing multiple priorities, with excellent communication and IT skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Strong calendar management and minute-taking skills are essential, alongside excellent attention to detail, discretion and the ability to build effective relationships. You will be a confident problem-solver who can manage deadlines, adapt to changing priorities and take ownership of your workload.

Why Oldfield Accountancy & Advisory:

Oldfield Accountancy & Advisory is a modern, forward-thinking accountancy practice based in Coventry, with over 50 years experience supporting small and medium-sized businesses. Providing expert accounting, tax and business growth advice, the firm helps clients improve profitability, cash flow and long-term value through tailored, results-driven solutions. With a strong focus on growth and professional development, Oldfield fosters a supportive culture built around five core values: Own It, Be Passionate, Go Further, Create Solutions and Earn Confidence.

If you have all the relevant skills and experience for the Executive Assistant role and would like to be considered, please apply by forwarding an up-to-date CV as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you.

Please check your email inbox and spam / junk mail folder for any email correspondence for this vacancy.

If you require any reasonable adjustments such as access or information in an alternative format, please inform us soon as you are able so that we can make the appropriate adjustments.

No recruitment agencies, please

This vacancy is being advertised and handled through Spider, the region s Online Job Advertiser on our behalf. We both take your privacy seriously. When you apply, your details are processed and available for us to directly review for this vacancy. As you might expect you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. For full Privacy Policy details please see email correspondences on receipt of your application.

title: HR & Recruitment Coordinator
description:
HR & Recruitment Coordinator Care Sector Coventry - on site £26.3 K Full Time Permanent

Gleeson Recruitment Group are working with a fantastic organisation who are looking for an HR Coordinator to join their team in Coventry. This is a great opportunity for an organised and proactive HR professional who enjoys working in a busy environment and wants a role with genuine variety across HR administration, recruitment and employee support.

The Role

Working closely with the HR team, you'll provide end-to-end administrative support across the employee lifecycle, with a particular focus on recruitment and maintaining accurate personnel records.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing high-volume recruitment administration from application through to appointment and induction
- Advertising vacancies and coordinating shortlisting and interview processes
- Preparing interview packs, schedules and recruitment documentation
- Supporting managers with recruitment activity and recruitment events
- Producing offer letters and contracts and processing contractual changes
- Coordinating pre-employment and safer recruitment checks, including references, DBS and employment history
- Maintaining accurate employee records, personnel files and probation information
- Supporting sickness absence and Return-to-Work administration
- Responding to HR queries professionally and confidentially
- Maintaining recruitment trackers, spreadsheets and HR records
- Supporting wider HR and office administration when required

About You

We're looking for someone who is highly organised, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

You'll ideally have:
- At least one year's office-based administration experience
- Some previous HR administration or recruitment experience
- Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills
- Experience handling confidential information
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Word and Excel
- The confidence to work independently and use your own initiative
- A professional, friendly and adaptable approach
- Ideally, CIPD Level 3 or an HR/Admin qualification

Why this role?

This is a fantastic opportunity for an HR Administrator/HR Assistant looking to develop their career within a supportive HR team. The role offers exposure across recruitment, HR administration, employee records and wider HR processes, giving you the opportunity to build strong, well-rounded HR experience.

Please note: this role is subject to an enhanced DBS check and medical clearance and requires flexibility to work across the organisation's Coventry and Birmingham sites when required.

To apply for the position, please click on the apply now button and your CV will be sent directly to the responsible recruiter. We will respond to successful applicants within 7 days, however please feel free to get in touch if you would like any further information about your application.

At Gleeson Recruitment Group, we embrace inclusivity and welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We are proud to be a disability confident employer.

By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Gleeson Recruitment Limited. Our Privacy Policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.

title: Part-Time Finance Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
An established, values-led organisation based in the Coventry is seeking a part-time Finance Assistant to join its finance team. This is a varied opportunity within a supportive environment where accuracy, confidentiality and strong administrative skills are key. The organisation offers an inclusive culture and is looking for someone who can work collaboratively while managing their own workload effectively.

Your new role
As Finance Assistant, you will support the finance function with day-to-day bookkeeping, financial administration and general accounting duties. Working 15 hours per week, you will assist with processing income and expenditure, maintaining accurate financial records, reconciling transactions and supporting the wider team with finance-related administration.
- Processing income and expenditure accurately and in line with finance procedures
- Supporting day-to-day bookkeeping using Xero and Microsoft Excel
- Maintaining records for income, expenditure, invoices, expenses and credit card transactions
- Assisting with sales invoices, customer billing and credit control support
- Reconciling transactions and ensuring documentation is retained appropriately
- Supporting audit preparation and general finance administration
- Working closely with colleagues across finance and the wider organisation

What you'll need to succeed
You will have previous experience working in a finance, accounts or bookkeeping role, ideally with exposure to an accounting system such as Xero, Sage or a similar package. You will be confident using Excel, have strong attention to detail and be comfortable handling confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
- At least 3 years' experience using an accounts package for bookkeeping or general finance administration
- Strong numeracy skills and high attention to detail
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office
- Experience processing invoices, expenses, reconciliations or financial records
- Excellent organisation and time-management skills
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to work with finance and non-finance colleagues
- A flexible, reliable and methodical approach to work
- AAT qualification or part-qualification would be advantageous but is not essential

What you'll get in return
This is a part-time Finance Assistant opportunity offering 13 hours per week within a supportive and friendly working environment. You will gain exposure to a varied finance role, working as part of a collaborative team where accuracy, organisation and professionalism are valued.

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.
